Suppose L is a finite extension of K. If 
  
    
      
        A
        ⊂
        B
        ⊂
        L
      
    
    {\displaystyle A\subset B\subset L}
  
 and B is reduced,
then B is a noetherian ring of dimension at most one.","description":"About extensions of one-dimensional Noetherian rings (commutative algebra)","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
